svg.text: BED v7 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Build each recessed plinth from FOUR actual strips; level with the case above.
2. Join case back, sides, bottom and top. Rout grip recesses only on internal panels.
3. Fit plywood L under Top and C between the two fronts; ends stop inside the sides.
4. Fit two drawer boxes per case with the retained 350 mm runners and equal gaps.
